description: Department of Cooperative Development - Cancellation of Registration of Cooperative Societies of Nuwara -  Eliya and Matale.
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the liquidation proceedings of multiple co-operative societies and calls for claims from members, officers, employees, and non-members who have done business with these societies. This falls under business/commercial matters as it deals with the dissolution and financial settlement of registered business entities (co-operative societies), making it a Commercial Gazette (Type 6).
